items.html: And now, still at this time, after the birth nothing enters but the Tzelem of Ima. And then ZA takes for his Keter only the lower third alone of the Tifferet of Bina. We find that what entered ZA from Bina was four measures and a third, which are the NHY and the Malchut of Bina, and the lower third of her Tifferet. And what is lacking from Bina must be doubled exactly opposite them, above: they are the two upper thirds of her Bina, and three complete measures, which are Daat, HG, and the two upper thirds that remained of her Tifferet, which did not enter ZA. These are four measures and a third of a measure, and these doubled and grew, and brought out the other four measures and a third that were lacking. And with this, the upper Bina was completed to ten Sefirot. And below, in the matter of the Keter, we shall broaden and lengthen this discourse, God willing.
